value.rationale: The initiating ecological model singles out the codimension-two degenerate boundary but leaves the finite observation-time behavior unresolved. An actual near-boundary competitor has a threshold-dependent probability-free passage/no-passage dichotomy, while near-resonant departure takes order 1/|c-1| with explicitly fear-dependent logarithmic coefficients. Unlike merely cataloguing a normal form, this specifies physical initial population sizes, the nearby saddle and fixed-threshold first passage; a useful motivated boundary result even without a global basin theorem.
